data.name: Streamer Survival
data.detailed_description:
Streamer Survival — The Survivor-like Game Where Your Chat Decides Your Survival

Streamer Survival is a frantic, survival-like game (in the style of Vampire:

Survivors) where you control the character… but the enemies are generated by your

chat in real time. Connect your Twitch, YouTube, or Kick stream and let

viewers type commands to summon custom waves,

modify the weather, or unleash bosses. Can you last 10 minutes while your

community does everything possible to destroy you?

What makes Streamer Survival unique?

In other games of this genre, the waves are predictable. Here, every

viewer actively participates without the need for donations or subscriptions:

simply type commands in the chat. The game reads the messages

natively and generates enemies with unique stats, temperature buffs

(heat/cold), random weather events, and a boss system that depends

on chat activity.

Commands your chat can use:

  • - !Zombie

  • - !Wolf

  • - !AnimalRobot

  • - !Paco

Main features:

  • - Survivor-like gameplay: move, dodge, level up, and improve your abilities while the chat closes in on you.

  • - Native integration with Twitch, YouTube, and Kick: no external plugins needed, it reads

  • chat commands directly.

  • - More than 10 enemy types with weather variations, random buffs, and unique behaviors.

  • - Progression per run: level up and choose upgrades during the run. Everything resets upon completion or restarting the run: each run starts from scratch.

  • - Streamer settings: adjust the average viewership to balance boss summons, the simultaneous enemy limit, and chat activity thresholds.

  • - Dynamic weather events: weather, storms, and paranormal zones that change the strategy in every match.

  • - Collaborative bosses: the chat must join in by repeatedly typing !BOSS for the real challenge to appear.

Are you a streamer? Customize the difficulty

In the options menu, enter your channel's average viewership (for example, 50, 200, or 1000). The game will use this number to calculate how many times

to type !BOSS in 2 minutes to summon a boss. This way, a small

channel won't be overwhelmed, and a large one will have a proportionate challenge.

data.short_description: A frantic survival-style game where you control the character while your chat (Twitch, YouTube, and Kick) generates enemies in real time using commands. Survive waves of enemies influenced by dynamic weather as your community does everything in its power to destroy you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1903 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 2 GB / AMD Radeon RX 460 2 GB (OpenGL 3.3 compatibility required)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with DirectX 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 4 GB (OpenGL 4.5 / Vulkan compatible recommended)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with DirectX 11

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 2 GB / AMD Radeon RX 460 2 GB (OpenGL 3.3 or NVIDIA proprietary driver 450+)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with PulseAudio / PipeWire
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.5+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 4 GB (Mesa 22.0+ / NVIDIA driver 515+ recommended)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with PulseAudio / PipeWire
